resources.string: Enable the subjects you use. All are off by default. Matching terms gain priority after the leading candidate, common single characters and your added words. Disabling a subject restores normal ordering and hides words supplied only by that subject; words already in the main dictionary remain available. Learning stays on this device. Delete the Chinese language pack to remove its domain data and settings.
This Chinese pack has no domain vocabulary. Import an updated Chinese pack under Languages → Chinese Input.
All off by default. Enable the subjects you use.
